authority.business_terminal: final publication or typed invocation terminal_ref
authority.agent_internal_state: legacy RunStore; opaque to this contract

sequence: durably create one compatibility work item
CAS START_QUEUED to EXECUTION_BOUND with stable workflow_run_id

claim.lease: renew only before expiry; expired or stale epoch cannot publish/ack
claim.deletion: source deletion_epoch must equal current non-deleted conversation epoch

execution.retryable_failure: release same job with the next claim epoch
execution.non_retryable_terminal: atomically acknowledge job and set invocation terminal_ref
execution.completed_recovery: read canonical final publication; do not regenerate
